program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for*/fold ([out g])
             ([r (in-range (- (rows g) 1))]
              [c (in-range (- (cols g) 1))])
    (let ((cells (list (list r c) (list r (+ c 1)) (list (+ r 1) c) (list (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
          (vals (list (at g r c) (at g r (+ c 1)) (at g (+ r 1) c) (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1)))))
      (if (and (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 4)) vals) 3)
               (= (count-where (lambda (v) (= v 0)) vals) 1))
          (let ((p (nth cells (let loop ([xs vals] [i 0])
                                (if (= (first xs) 0) i (loop (rest xs) (+ i 1)))))))
            (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 9))
          out))))
